headline: CLIENT MONDAY CLOSED WITH THREE DECISIONS YOU MADE YOURSELF — 198 Rena is cancelled and expires tonight, the drafts folder went from eleven to zero because you sent them by hand, and two rules that had been blocking the machine for days got ruled inside three minutes this afternoon. · DO: call Amy G. — 355 Comanche, day three · WATCH: auto-drafts still exceed the cash they draw from, day 15 unposted.

notes: 🎯 THE BOARD'S OWN HEADLINE WAS ANSWERED BY YOU AT 1:13 THIS AFTERNOON, AND THE ANSWER WAS NO. Every lane in this fleet spent the weekend arguing about whether 198 Rena would be reinstated or extended, and four separate sources agreed only that the clock ran out today. You settled it in five sentences to the seller: the listing expires this evening, the sign comes down today or tomorrow, the lockbox is being collected, everyone who had expressed interest has been told it is off the market, and all ads and media are stopped. ⭐ WORTH SAYING PLAINLY: this closes the single oldest open decision on the board — the 'no lane has ever sighted the signed document' problem is moot, because there is no document to sight. ⚠️ ONE MECHANICAL CONSEQUENCE THE MACHINE SHOULD OWN RATHER THAN YOU: the milestone engine still carries this address as OFFER_RECEIVED and the listing roster still counts it active. Those will read wrong until they are corrected, and 'we have stopped all ads and media' is an instruction the marketing lane has not yet been shown.

✅ THE DRAFTS FOLDER IS EMPTY FOR THE FIRST TIME IN WEEKS, AND YOU ARE THE REASON. It stood at seven this morning and the lead lane staged four more Walton County notes at 10:12. Tonight a full scan returns exactly ONE draft in the whole account, and it is a relic from 2024 — nothing machine-staged is pending anywhere. ⭐ THE RECEIPTS ARE IN YOUR SENT MAIL: the four expired-listing notes went out around 3:15 this afternoon, alongside a past-client reconnect and an updated valuation note to a homeowner who had asked twice. ⭐ WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS: the standing rule on this fleet says a staged draft is not follow-up and a sent message is, and the draft queue has been the fleet's most reliable source of fake progress for a month. Zero pending is the healthiest that number has been since it started being measured.

⚖️ TWO RULINGS LANDED AT 4:58 AND 5:00, AND ONE QUESTION IS STILL OPEN AT DAY TEN. You ruled that a number a lead typed into your own form overrides a do-not-call badge on that same number — which released eight first-touch texts that had been frozen pending your call — and you ruled that the Monday client review emails may be staged as drafts, which unblocks eight seller emails across eleven listings that the review routine refused to write this morning rather than breach the send rule. Both are now written to disk rather than living in a session, which is the lesson from the migration that lost a ruling once already. ⚠️ TWO HONEST CAVEATS: six of the eight thawed texts still have not gone out — the browser tool blocked the batch partway through — and the co-op-agent question you were asked on 8/8 is still unruled, which is what is holding the two nine-day-overdue price calls and the note to the agent whose buyers put your listing at the top of their list. ⚠️ Also unchanged and worth not losing: the accounting platform has refused sign-in on three consecutive runs, so nothing can be posted to the books.

callBlock.who: Amy G. of Ethos International — her buyers put 355 Comanche TOP OF THEIR LIST, and this is day three
callBlock.why: 🔥 STILL THE BEST SIGNAL ON THE BOARD AND STILL THE OLDEST UNWORKED ONE. She filed Saturday at 11:24 PM off that afternoon's tour: interested — YES, and in her own words her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and have put it at the top of their list. ⭐ WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM EVERY OTHER YES ON THIS HOUSE: she is the same agent who phoned you from inside the home mid-showing, and you already answered half of what she asked by text. This is a returned call, not a cold approach. 🔴 THE HALF YOU DID NOT ANSWER IS STILL OPEN — she reported the basement lights would not come on, and buyers who have 'just started looking' are touring other houses this week with a dark basement as their last memory of yours. ⚠️ NOTHING NEW HAS ARRIVED SINCE: the showing feed has been completely silent for roughly forty-two hours across all eight active listings, so this signal has not been overtaken, it has only aged. ⭐ She left BOTH price fields blank and scored staging a 3 — the only agent to score staging since the cut, so ask her what she would change. ⛔ Call, don't email — the co-op lane is still the unruled question.

callBlock.who: James P. — a $1.89M Indian Springs owner who says YOUR estimate on his own house is TOO LOW
callBlock.why: 🔥 THE HIGHEST-INTENT SHAPE A SELLER LEAD EVER TAKES, AND STILL THE BIGGEST NUMBER TO ARRIVE IN WEEKS. He came to your site Sunday morning, saw the automated value on his Miller Circle property, and told you it was too low. ⭐ AN OWNER ARGUING ABOUT HIS OWN NUMBER IS NOT BROWSING — he has a price in his head, which means he has a plan, and he is inviting the conversation about what the house is really worth. ✅ OWNERSHIP IS FULLY SETTLED: it cleared both verification methods this morning and the shared-pool question was affirmatively ruled out, so the caveat that sat on this record all weekend is dead. ✅ His first touch went out at 7:13 this morning the moment the window opened, and the lead lane logged it clean. ⏰ SO THE CALL IS THE FOLLOW-THROUGH, NOT THE OPENER — and a Sunday hand-raise that hears nothing by Wednesday is talking to somebody else.

callBlock.who: Marie R. — she came back on a North Port FL market report and asked for the number done by hand
callBlock.why: 🆕 THE FRESHEST SELLER-SHAPED ASK ON THE BOARD. She is on your market-report list for a Snowflake Lane property, pulled it up again over the weekend, got this morning's note at 9:48, and came back asking for a real valuation rather than the automated one. ⭐ THAT IS THE EXACT CONVERSION THE MARKET-REPORT LANE EXISTS TO PRODUCE — a passive report reader turning into an active seller question — and it is the only one of forty notes sent this morning that produced one. ⏰ IT ALSO DECAYS FASTEST OF ANYTHING HERE, because she asked TODAY and the value of answering a valuation request drops by the hour. ⚠️ SAID HONESTLY: this is out of market for you directly, so the call is as much about whether it is a referral as whether it is a listing — but somebody should be talking to her tonight or tomorrow, and right now nobody is.

callBlock.who: Christopher L. — second homeowner in one weekend to call your estimate on his own house TOO LOW
callBlock.why: 🔥 THE SAME SHAPE AS THE $1.89M ONE, ON THE SAME WEEKEND, WHICH IS THE PATTERN WORTH NOTICING. He told your site that the estimate on his Lake Circle home was too low. Two owners disputing their own valuations upward inside twenty-four hours is not a coincidence — it is what a market with rising seller confidence looks like from inside your own data. ⭐ THE ANSWER IS NOT A NUMBER, IT IS A CONVERSATION: he is telling you he thinks his house is worth more, and the fastest route to a listing appointment is to agree that the automated estimate is a starting point and offer to do the real one by hand. ✅ First touch went out this morning inside the window, and he also received the market-report note at 9:48. ⏰ A seller who raises a hand on Sunday is talking to somebody by Wednesday.

callBlock.who: Cassie C. of RE/MAX Advantage — she wrote the offer, called the old price too high, and still has not been told it moved
callBlock.why: 🔴 NINE DAYS OVERDUE, AND EVERY DAY THAT PASSES MAKES THE CASE STRONGER RATHER THAN WEAKER. Her buyer toured 355 Comanche in late July, she wrote the offer, and she called the ask too high — at a number that no longer exists. She has never been told the price came down. ⭐ FIVE CONSECUTIVE READS SINCE THE CUT HAVE DECLINED TO ARGUE THE NUMBER, including Saturday night's YES. The pricing question on this house is settled; what is not settled is that an agent who already wrote one offer is still working off a dead figure. ⛔ Quote the current list price only, and CALL rather than email — co-op agents sit in the no-email lane, and that is precisely the ruling that is now ten days open. ⭐ Two of today's three decisions were the questions the fleet had been holding; this is the third one, and it costs two phone calls and no negotiation.

callBlock.who: Angela B. of Keller Williams Vestavia — interested buyer, same dead price, same nine days
callBlock.why: 🔴 THE TWIN OF THE ROW ABOVE AND IT COSTS THE SAME THING. Her buyer toured 355 Comanche in early August, she filed interested — YES, and she called the ask too high. Like Cassie, she filed before the cut and has never heard the number moved. ⭐ TWO AGENTS WITH INTERESTED BUYERS ON YOUR HIGHEST-TRAFFIC ACTIVE LISTING, BOTH WORKING OFF A PRICE THAT NO LONGER EXISTS, is the cheapest fixable loss on the whole board. ⛔ Same rule: current list price only, and call rather than email.

callBlock.who: Gloria F. — the tenant answer is now twenty-four days owed
callBlock.why: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD, AND IT CROSSED THREE WEEKS THIS WEEKEND WITH NOTHING TO SHOW TODAY. She waited nineteen days without complaining, then escalated three times in twenty-seven minutes on a Wednesday night — two voicemails and a text. ✅ THE EMERGENCY HALF RESOLVED WITHOUT YOU: power is back on at the property and the tenant paid his balance, both confirmed. ⭐ THAT MAKES THE CALL EASIER, NOT UNNECESSARY — what she actually asked is still unanswered: is the tenant out, because he owes another month if he is not. ⭐ YOU DO NOT NEED THE ANSWER TO MAKE THE CALL, and waiting for one is exactly what turned six days into twenty-four. ⭐ She is not a loose end — she closed with you in June and still opens your market reports.

callBlock.who: Thomas D. — he said YES, he has the document he asked for, and nobody has called
callBlock.why: ✅ THIS IS THE ONE THAT UNBLOCKED ITSELF AND THEN STALLED ANYWAY. He replied 'Yes' on Friday and asked for the 19-lot layout and the per-acre number. 🆕 THE PLAT WAS LOCATED AND EMAILED THE SAME MORNING — the exact deliverable his open chip had been waiting on. ⭐ SO THE CALL IS NO LONGER A HOLDING REPLY, IT IS A FOLLOW-UP ON SOMETHING HE ALREADY HAS IN HAND, which is a completely different conversation. 🔥 He is one of nine names off the 19-lot land ad, and that ad remains the only advertising in the portfolio producing anything at all — it produced yet another buyer at 4:31 this afternoon, answered inside the hour. ⏰ Three days since he answered. The gap between 'he said yes' and 'nobody called' is where this one dies.

listings.status: 🛑 CANCELLED — expires tonight, sign coming down, all ads and media stopped
listings.note: 🛑 THE DECISION THIS BOARD HAS BEEN CARRYING FOR FOUR DAYS IS MADE, AND YOU MADE IT AT 1:13 THIS AFTERNOON. Your note to Ann is unambiguous: the listing expires this evening, the sign gets picked up today or tomorrow, Don is grabbing the lockbox, everyone who had expressed interest has been told it is off the market, and all ads and media are stopped. ⭐ THE READ THIS BOARD OWES YOU IS THAT IT WAS THE RIGHT SHAPE OF CALL ON THE EVIDENCE: day 92, no price change since May, exactly one written offer all summer, the 8/11 'full-price showing' this board carried for two days never happened by the agent's own admission, Friday's tour produced total silence, and the unrepresented buyer who phoned Thursday about the workshop stood down Sunday. Both feedback forms this house ever produced left every price field blank — the objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior, never the number. A house nobody argues the price on, that nobody buys, is a house with a positioning problem the seller was not going to fix. ⚠️ THREE MECHANICAL LOOSE ENDS THE MACHINE OWNS, NOT YOU: the milestone engine still carries this address as OFFER_RECEIVED, the listing roster still counts it among the actives, and 'we have stopped all ads and media' has not been shown to the marketing lane — a queued or live placement on a cancelled listing is exactly the class of error this board flagged twice this week on other addresses. ⭐ AND THE RELATIONSHIP IS INTACT, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS PAST THIS WEEK: you handled the cancellation personally, in writing, with the sign and the box already arranged. That is how a cancelled listing becomes a future one.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — closes THURSDAY, and it is still the quietest high-risk file you have
listings.note: ⏰ THREE DAYS OUT AND THIS IS NOW THE NEAREST HARD DATE ON THE BOARD BY A WIDE MARGIN. ✅ What is verified and good: the appraisal is complete and clean on the lender's own words, the repair addendum is fully executed, the septic inspection ran 8/4, and the closing invite matches the stored state on the engine's own cross-check, run again this evening and passed. ⭐ CLOSING IS THURSDAY 8/20 AT 3:00 PM at the closing attorney's office. ✅ THE BROKERAGE ISSUED THE COMMISSION DOCUMENT SATURDAY — the step three separate reminders had been chasing — which starts the payment clock on the largest number closing this month. ⚠️ THE HONEST WORRY IS THE SILENCE, NOT A PROBLEM: this desk has called it the quietest high-risk file in the book for a week, and a full day of Monday traffic has come and gone with nothing new on it. Three days out with no motion is worth one confirmation call to the attorney tomorrow rather than an assumption. ⚠️ AND IT MATTERS MORE THAN USUAL THIS WEEK: the funds from this closing land somewhere between late this month and early next, which is AFTER the tightest cash week of the quarter. This closing does not rescue this week, and planning as though it does is the one real risk on an otherwise clean file. ⛔ The old 8/14 close date is retired — do not re-print it anywhere.

listings.status: 📸 Coming to market $185K — photos shot today, agreement delivered, and the BUY half finally opened
listings.note: ✅ THE BEST-MOVING FILE ON THE BOARD TODAY AND THE ONE THIS DESK HAD BEEN LOUDEST ABOUT. The photo shoot happened, both halves of it closed on your word Sunday. ✅ AND THE HALF NOBODY HAD EVER WORKED IS NOW OPEN — at 3:17 this afternoon you asked Sondra whether tomorrow afternoon works to go see the property she is interested in, and in the same message told them the listing agreement had come through and offered to cover any questions on it while you are together. ⭐ THAT IS THE TWO-SIDED DEAL FINALLY BEING WORKED AS A TWO-SIDED DEAL. She came in unprompted saying she was very interested in a property AND about ready to list their own; the LIST half has been in motion since Friday's seven executed documents, and until this afternoon the BUY half had never been touched by anyone. ⭐ WHAT THAT MEANS FOR THE FILE: a buy-side showing tomorrow, a listing agreement in their hands, and one appointment that covers both. 🔴 THE ONE STEP STILL BETWEEN THIS HOUSE AND THE MARKET IS MLS INPUT — photos are shot, so the input prep is the gate on going live this weekend. ⚠️ Still true: no buyer criteria or budget is recorded anywhere in the system, so tomorrow's showing is also the intake. ⚠️ The $185,000 price is your own ruling and is quotable, but it still has no primary MLS source behind it.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — top of a buyer's list, and the call is now three days old
listings.note: 🔥 THE BEST NEWS ON THE BOARD IS ALSO THE OLDEST UNWORKED THING ON IT, AND A FULL BUSINESS DAY PASSED WITHOUT MOVING IT. Amy G. of Ethos International filed Saturday at 11:24 PM off that afternoon's tour: interested — YES, staged 3, and in her own words her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and have put it at the top of their list. ⭐ SHE IS THE SAME AGENT WHO PHONED YOU FROM INSIDE THE HOUSE mid-showing, so the channel is already warm — this is a returned call, not a cold approach. ✅ THE PRICING QUESTION IS ANSWERED AS FIRMLY AS FEEDBACK CAN ANSWER IT: she left BOTH price fields blank, making FIVE consecutive reads since the 8/5 cut where nobody argued the number. Every read that ever said TOO HIGH was filed while the ask was $299,000. A $4,000 experiment that worked — do not reopen price with this seller. 🔴 THE LIVE ITEM IS THE BASEMENT LIGHTS. She reported on the phone that they would not turn on; you answered the garage half by text and that half is closed. This half is not, and it is the cheapest thing on this listing to fix. ⭐ She scored staging a 3 and is the ONLY agent to score staging since the cut, so she is worth asking what she would change. 🔴 Two co-op agents who expressed buyer interest still do not know the price moved — both chips overdue since 8/8, now nine days, and both blocked behind the same unruled question. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only. ⛔ Call, don't email. ⚠️ One older thread is still unanswered: the 8/10 agent asked in writing whether the ceiling stains came from a previous leak. 📊 Seventeen showings all-time, still the highest-traffic active in the book — and no new booking since Saturday.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $550K — three tours with nothing back, and the seller just changed how feedback reaches them
listings.note: 🆕 THE FEEDBACK GAP GOT AN ACTUAL FIX TODAY, AND IT CAME FROM THE SELLER'S SIDE. At 3:08 this afternoon the institutional seller asked that showing feedback be routed to them directly through the showing platform to take the back-and-forth off your plate; you forwarded it to your operations manager at 3:09 and she confirmed it done at 3:27. ⭐ WHY THAT IS THE RIGHT NEWS ON THIS PARTICULAR FILE: this listing is three showings deep with not one word returned — two separate agents walked it Saturday six hours apart, taking the all-time counter from 41 to 42 in a single day, and the 8/10 tour before them never filed either. This has been the single biggest information gap on the board for four days, and the fix landed inside twenty minutes without you touching it. ✅ THE SOURCE PROBLEM THIS BOARD FLAGGED FOR TWO DAYS IS CLOSED: both Saturday notices print the list price at $550,000, confirmed independently and quotable. Every prior notice printed $559,000 because they all predated the cut. ⭐ THE TIMING IS THE POINT — the cut went live 8/13 and produced two tours inside forty-eight hours on a house whose last read called it too high. That is the market answering the question directly. 🔴 THE ITEM THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED UNACTIONED FOR THREE WEEKS IS STILL THE ONE THAT WOULD MOVE THE NEEDLE: the 7/23 read said dirty plus GLITCHING ELECTRICAL, and the 8/4 read scored staging 2 of 5, the lowest this listing has ever recorded, against a 4 three weeks earlier from an agent who called the price JUST RIGHT. The house did not get more expensive between those visits — it got less presentable. An electrician and a cleaner remain cheaper than another lost buyer. ⚠️ The live 8/10 social post still carries $559,000 until the replacement is approved.

listings.status: 🎉 Under contract $390,000 — the response went out, and the duplicate draft is finally gone
listings.note: ✅ THE HAZARD THIS BOARD HAS NAMED FOR THREE DAYS IS CLEARED. The inspection-response letter to the sellers was never unsent — you sent it yourself Saturday at 9:54 — and the document sitting in the drafts folder was a DUPLICATE created six minutes later. Tonight's scan finds the drafts folder empty, so that duplicate is gone along with everything else in it. Two separate reads called it 'unsent for 24 hours'; both were reading the copy, not the original, and the correction is now closed rather than carried. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE ASK IS THE STORY AND IT IS GOOD NEWS: they inspected seventy-one items, flagged sixty-eight at some level, and then asked for exactly three. That is a reasonable buyer. ⭐ THE RECOMMENDATION YOU SENT IS TWO YESES AND A HOLD — agree to the basement leak and to a scoped HVAC service, and on the roof do not say no, say give us a few days and our own licensed roofer's report. The inspector wrote in the same section that he cannot determine the roof's age or remaining life, which is the report itself saying the roof question is unanswered. ⚠️ TWO THINGS BEFORE FIGHTING THE ROOF: this is FHA, so the appraiser can raise it independently, and the concession room left under the FHA cap is small, so this gets solved with work rather than a check. ✅ The sellers have acknowledged the roof-holdback approach. 🔴 THE OPEN QUESTION IS A DEADLINE NOBODY CAN READ: the date the buyers' repair-resolution window actually closes does not exist anywhere in this system, on this file or any other. That gap is the subject of a queued proposal and it is live right here. ⭐ Closing 10/23 — roughly ten weeks, which is a luxury most files do not get.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract — both gates cleared, close 8/28, and the seller is STILL waiting on a call
listings.note: ✅ STILL THE CLEANEST FILE ON YOUR BOARD ON PAPER, AND THE ENGINE RE-CHECKED THE CLOSE DATE AGAIN THIS EVENING AND IT PASSED. Both gates are behind you: the inspection ran 8/5 at noon and the appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary notices. ⭐ AN INSPECTION AND AN APPRAISAL BOTH SPENT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION ANY DEAL ON THIS BOARD OCCUPIES. ✅ AND THE ONE THING THAT COULD HAVE BITTEN IT GOT CAUGHT WITHOUT YOU: your operations manager chased and closed the payoff item on 8/14, with two status comments on the record. That is the catch that protects the close, and she was quick on a second request today as well — worth acknowledging to her this week. 🔴 AND YET THE SELLER HAS BEEN WAITING ON A RETURNED CALL SINCE LAST TUESDAY — seven days now, mid-transaction, on the deal with the least to worry about. ⭐ A CLIENT MID-TRANSACTION WHO CALLS AND GETS NOTHING BACK IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE SILENCE YOU CAN BUY, because it costs the referral rather than the closing. Today was Client Day and this is exactly the row it existed for; it did not get worked. ⚠️ A milestone signal on this address was reviewed again this evening and correctly declined — an HVAC concession discussion that maps to a rung already spent — so nothing new has broken. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back — day eleven, reported as a single-source observation rather than an alarm. ⚠️ One number remains unruled and is worth real money on an otherwise settled deal: the buyer's agent asked for a specific co-op commission and nobody has ever answered.

listings.status: 🎉 Under contract $162K — inspection held, both price reads validated the number
listings.note: ✅ THE FIRST GATE IS BEHIND YOU — inspection confirmed and held 8/13 at 10:00 AM; MLS reads CONTINGENT. ✅ THE PAPERWORK ITEM IS CLOSED, NOT PENDING: the contract went out with all signatures, the contract-to-close packet reached title 8/12, and the closing attorney confirmed receipt. ⚠️ REPAIR REQUESTS CAME IN AND WERE REVIEWED BY THE MILESTONE ENGINE THIS EVENING — it correctly declined to fire, because the rung they map to is already spent. That is the watcher working, not a new problem, but it does mean a repair conversation is live on this unit and nothing about it has reached this board in detail. 🔴 ONE THREAD IS NOT CLOSED: the seller's initials on a specific paragraph have been sitting unsent for five days on your operations manager's side, and this morning's inbox triage raised it as closing-critical rather than housekeeping. On a file this clean that is a process gap — but it is the kind that becomes a deal risk quietly. ⭐ TWO INDEPENDENT READS VALIDATE THIS PRICE — the agent who wrote the offer called it JUST RIGHT, and a late form off the 8/7 tour said interested No but PRICED JUST RIGHT with a staging 3 of 5. ⭐ THE BACKSTORY IS WORTH KEEPING: the buyer's agent said her client really liked it but needed to save more for a down payment, and this desk argued for two weeks against reading that as a price signal. She wrote. Offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. Patience was the right call. ⭐ Closing 9/14.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $184K — a 'VERY interested' buyer is now nine days unworked
listings.note: 🔥 THE LISTING THIS BOARD ONCE CALLED INVISIBLE PRODUCED THREE TOURS IN A SINGLE SATURDAY, all three forms filed within ninety minutes of each other on 8/8. One answered the interest question with the single word 'Very' and left every other field blank — which is exactly why it needs a phone call: the enthusiasm is on record and the reason is not. ✅ THE $5,000 CUT IS VERIFIED LIVE AND PUBLIC — the MLS line on all three notices reads $184,000, so the old do-not-quote hedge is retired. 🔴 THE REAL FINDING IS THE OBJECTION AND IT IS VERIFIED THREE WAYS: the problem is SIZE, not price. The clearest read says it in four words — 'Just too small.' ⛔ NO DISCOUNT REACHES A SIZE OBJECTION. The answer here is AUDIENCE — first-time buyers, downsizers, investors — and a price conversation with this seller would be solving the wrong problem. This board argued for a cut here for weeks on the strength of silence; the showings arrived and said something different, and that earlier read is withdrawn. 🔴 That Saturday burst has now fully decayed with the one phone call still unmade, and no new booking has come in since.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $599K package — NINTH name off the ad today, and the septic answer is STILL undelivered
listings.note: 🔥 THE AD PRODUCED AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON — a new buyer came off the 19-lot listing at 4:31 PM and was answered inside the hour with the package terms and the per-lot math. That is the ninth name off this one ad, while every other ad in the portfolio has produced zero, and the third in three days. ⭐ WORTH STATING AS A STRATEGY FACT RATHER THAN A NICE RESULT: one land ad is out-producing the entire rest of the marketing spend combined, and nothing on the board is being moved toward it. ✅ THE DELIVERABLE WAS LOCATED FRIDAY — the 19-lot plat, precisely what the open buyer chip had been waiting on since he answered 'Yes', and it went out the same morning. 🔴 THE THING THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU MOST ON THIS FILE IS NOT THE COUNTY, IT IS THE HANDOFF, AND IT IS NOW DAY FIVE: the builder asked the septic perc question on 8/12, your operations manager researched and answered it completely, and that answer has been sitting on her board since Friday with nobody reading it back to him. The work was done; the delivery never happened. ⭐ THE PERC QUESTION ITSELF IS PRICED RATHER THAN BLOCKED: the county takes record searches in person only, weekdays 8:00 to 3:30, at a per-record fee — across nineteen lots that is a four-figure errand. ⭐ SO THE CHOICE IS THREE-WAY, NOT TWO: send someone for all nineteen, narrow the pull to the lots a buyer is actually asking about, or try the free path first and ask the developer, who almost certainly already holds the perc results from platting. ⭐ PERC DECIDES BUILDABILITY AND BUILDABILITY DECIDES PRICE PER LOT, which is why this one question governs the whole package. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses hard-bounced permanently — part of the builder audience received nothing at all, and those two need replacing rather than resending.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the counter has never been put on paper, day 27
listings.note: 🔴 THE LARGEST SINGLE NUMBER ON YOUR BOARD, ROUGHLY $36K OF GCI, AND THE WHOLE COST OF MOVING IT IS TWENTY MINUTES OF WRITING. The listing side has asked repeatedly since 7/21 to be moved forward and has never received a written position from your side. ⚠️ STATED HONESTLY: a phone call leaves no receipt, so this is ABSENCE rather than proven failure — but what was promised was paper, and there is none on any lane this desk can read. ⭐ WHY IT KEEPS RETURNING: a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal, and the honest answer IS the counter. Sending it is not a favour to them; it is your position on the record. ⚠️ NOT ASSERTED, AND THIS MATTERS BEFORE ANYTHING GOES OVER: the appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him. Whose appraisal it is, when it was done, and whether it is a formal appraisal at all are all unknown. Do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value. 🛑 A RELATED ITEM IS LIVE AND STILL UNRULED: the counter structure the other side asked for on a separate buyer file — written counter or a subject-to / seller-finance shape — has been waiting on your call since 8/13. ✅ The duplicate-draft problem on that thread resolved itself today when the drafts folder was cleared.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — the tenant answer is twenty-four days owed
listings.note: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD, AND A FULL CLIENT MONDAY PASSED WITHOUT IT MOVING. She left a twenty-two-second voicemail on 7/25 rather than sending a seventh text — which is what a patient client does when nothing comes back — and then escalated THREE TIMES IN TWENTY-SEVEN MINUTES on a Wednesday night: two voicemails and a text. ✅ THE EMERGENCY HALF RESOLVED WITHOUT YOU — power is back on at the property and the tenant paid his balance, both confirmed. ⭐ THE OWED THING IS STILL YOURS: she asked whether the tenant on this unit is out, because he owes another month's rent if he isn't. ⚠️ YOU DO NOT NEED AN ANSWER TO MAKE THIS CALL. 'Still no word from him, here's exactly what I'm doing about it' beats a twenty-fifth day of silence. ⭐ She is not a loose end — she closed with you in June, still opens your market reports, and has an unclosed valuation loop on this same address.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — seventeen days quiet, and the good news is STILL undelivered
listings.note: 🔴 TWO TOURS IN FIVE DAYS AT THE END OF JULY, THEN NOTHING SINCE. On a listing that had gone 126 days with essentially no traffic, that brief burst was the only real activity this file has produced and it has fully decayed. ⭐ THE GOOD NEWS IS STILL UNDELIVERED AT SEVENTEEN DAYS, WHICH MAKES IT THE OLDEST OWED ITEM ON THE BOARD: the 7/31 read came back interested No, but with the price called JUST RIGHT, a 4 of 5 rating, and the comment that the buyers prefer the east end of the beach although they liked this complex.
